text: The imam giving your Friday khutbah... and your fiancé... have the same name in Arabic.
Khateeb. The one who gives the khutbah... and also, your fiancé.
Both come from khataba: to address. The imam addresses the people... a suitor addresses a family.
And the two words look almost the same:
One small mark changes it. With a damma, it's a sermon. With a kasra, it's a proposal.
Your turn. This is from al-Baqarah. Sermon, or proposal? Look at the mark under the first letter.
A PROPOSAL! The kasra gives it away.
So listen closely at Jumuah today! Send this to someone who's getting married... and comment: did you spot it?
